# ADR-0002: Poll Locker Status Every Minute

**Status:** Superseded by ADR-0003

**Date:** 2026-02-10

**Deciders:** Lockerline platform team

## Context

This ADR builds your capability to reason about freshness. Status was read on
demand.

## Decision

We will poll every locker once a minute.

## Reflection prompts

- What did polling cost?
